lang1.bullet1: For root development and plant growth
lang1.bullet3: For enhanced crop yield and quality

composition.label: Composition:
composition.value: Azospirillum brasilense, Bacillus subtilis, Bacillus amyloliquefaciens, Trichoderma harzianum. Total concentration — not less than 1 x 10⁹ cfu/g.

usage.label: Application rate:
usage.value: 0.5–1 kg/ha. For more information scan the QR code.

preparation.label: Preparation:
preparation.value: Mix the required amount of BioNPK Powder S with 200–400 l of water and spray/irrigate. Before adding to the sprayer, it is recommended to dissolve the required amount of BioNPK Powder S in a separate container with water and then pour this solution into the sprayer. BioNPK Powder S is added to the sprayer last.

storage.label: Storage conditions:
storage.value: The product, in a tightly sealed, original packaging, in dry, well-ventilated areas, protected from direct sunlight, can be stored for 18 months at +5 – +30 °C.

manufacturer.label: Manufacturer:
manufacturer.value: UAB "Nando", Europos av. 39, LT-46329 Kaunas, Lithuania
